criteriaNotes.view34: All cells read as flat ground seen from above. Isolated 2x2 masses become a ~1-cell dark tuft and 2-wide strips become ~1-cell-wide strips with a regular nub fringe; at 1x these read as dark grass patches, not plant objects (no outline, no volume shading).
criteriaNotes.seams: Re-rendered the autotile myself (bits N1 E2 S4 W8 NE16 SE32 SW64 NW128, diagonal only with both cardinals) on bands, crosses, diagonal joins, random and cellular-automaton fields for both families. 0 runs (>=4 px) of dark/light mismatch along tile borders; dark/light transitions cluster at x,y%16=6..8 (mid-cell), border columns have the fewest. 0 isolated dark pixels. Light pinholes inside dark: 483/696 are the original 11628 highlight (729c44); the rest are single base-colour dither pixels inside cells 681/682/683/691/695/696 (and woodland twins) at cell-interior positions. Interior texture continuous across edge/interior boundaries.
criteriaNotes.colour: Woodland adds 759951/688c48/81a359/8aab60 (6501/1341/882/70 px), a uniform desaturation of 737's ramp; dark ramp untouched. Sits naturally with crowns and the sheet; no off-palette look.
criteriaNotes.style: Edge cells reuse the 11628 dark texture and 737/650 texture; fringe is pixel dither in the sheet's language, no smeared or noise-generated look. Variant groups (e.g. 667-670, 675-676) are intentionally identical because extra cardinals without diagonals do not form a 2x2 mass.
criteriaNotes.maps: In s1-s8 and r10 renders the dark floor reads as forest ground under the crowns; edges are blob-shaped with chamfered corners, no one-lobe-per-tile sawtooth and no per-tile square slabs. Residual risk, not failed: long straight painted runs give ruler-straight edges (no large-scale wobble variants). Unrelated to these cells: bright 509730 rectangles in r10-courtyard and a 32451e line at x=448 in r10-river-3 come from other tiles/overlays; path tiles in woodland maps carry 737 fringe next to 650.

cells.reasons: Woodland base: same texture as city 737, uniformly desaturated with the 4 new colours; reads as flat ground, sits naturally next to 651+ on the sheet and under original crowns in s1-s8 / r10-route maps.
